newsitem.title: USA: Genzyme reports strong Q3 product sales.
newsitem.headline: Genzyme reports strong Q3 product sales.

text.p: Genzyme Corp on Thursday said its product and service sales for the third quarter were $134.3 million, up 52 percent from $88.2 million a year earlier.
The rise was partly due to sales from Deknatel Snowden Pencer (DSP), a surgical products company acquired at the start of the third quarter, Genzyme said.
It said sales of its products Ceredase and Cerezyme, enzymes for the treatment of Gaucher disease, reached $69 million in the third quarter, up 24 percent from a year ago.

"The strong showing of Ceredase and Cerezyme has put us on track toward our $300 million market estimate for those two products," said Henri Termeer, Genzyme's chairman and chief executive officer, in a statement.
Genzyme's general division reported third quarter revenues of $141.0 million, up 49 percent from the same period last year.
Genzyme earnings per share of $0.29, before one-time charges associated with the DSP acquisition, were up from a fully diluted $0.24 a year ago.
First Call's consensus estimate for the quarter was $0.27.
